Entry.JapaneseText: ぷにぷにぽよぽよ
Entry.EnglishText: Squishy and Soft
Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title for Couleur https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Couleur:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: 触ったときの不思議な感触はなんとも言えないけど 病みつきになっちゃう。手触り最高の不思議な生物
Entry.EnglishText: The feeling of touching her is indescribable and addictive. A mysterious creature, but she has the most wonderful texture!

Entry.JapaneseText: ゆうかんなるもの
Entry.EnglishText: Courageous One
Entry.Notes: Event: encounter Dhaos at Ethos's House

Entry.JapaneseText: どんなに強い敵にでも勇猛果敢にタックルだ！ ボールみたいにぶっ飛ばされてもめげないぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: She'll dauntlessly tackle even the strongest foes! You can toss her like a ball, too, and it's so cute! ...But you still won't win!
Entry.Notes: pun, meganai -> kachimeganai (can't win) but also meganai (addictive)

Entry.JapaneseText: ひみつってなぁに？
Entry.EnglishText: But... What's the Secret?

Entry.JapaneseText: バラしちゃいけないから、秘密。 秘密は『秘密』と言った時点でヒミツじゃない
Entry.EnglishText: It would be bad if everyone knew, so it's a secret. And if you have to say, "don't tell, it's a secret," it's not a secret anymore.

Entry.JapaneseText: かんしやく
Entry.EnglishText: Overseer
Entry.Notes: Event: Clear the game (required: title transfer)

Entry.JapaneseText: ずっと彼らを見守ってきた。ふたりが何を 考えてるのか、どんな結論を出すか、じっと注意深く
Entry.EnglishText: She watched over them from beginning to end. What are they thinking, how will it all end? Ever watching, ever wondering.

Entry.JapaneseText: 小さな生き物
Entry.EnglishText: Tiny Creature

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１５、ちょっと強くなったけど、この緑の 小さな体にはもっと強い力が秘められてる……はず
Entry.EnglishText: At level 15, she's gotten a bit stronger, but this tiny green body of hers conceals even greater power... Um, probably.

Entry.JapaneseText: 小さな闘志
Entry.EnglishText: Tiny Fighter
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 50 Maxle - Literally Tiny Fighting Spirit, but considering "spirit" is an actual term used in Phantasia, I don't think it makes sense to use it since he's not a spirit like that.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル５０、小さな体に秘めた、人に負けない力あり。 目には見えないものだけど、一度見たならみんな驚く
Entry.EnglishText: At level 50, the strength in her tiny body rivals any man's. She doesn't look it, but see her in action and it's a sight to behold.

Entry.JapaneseText: 小さな勇者
Entry.EnglishText: Tiny Hero

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１００、戦い方を小さな体にしっかり刻む。 はねてるだけに見えるけど、これもクルール流兵法！
Entry.EnglishText: At level 100, she's carved the art of combat into her tiny body. It looks like she's just bouncing, but that, too, is Couleur Style Tactics!

Entry.JapaneseText: 小さな豪傑
Entry.EnglishText: Tiny Superhero

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル２００、小さな体に宿るすさまじい威圧感。 ヒグマよりも大きく見えて、魔物たちをたじろがせる
Entry.EnglishText: At level 200, her tiny body emanates a terrifying, overpowering aura. She looks bigger than a grizzly, and monsters flinch at her sight.

Entry.JapaneseText: つっかまえたー
Entry.EnglishText: Caught You!
Entry.Notes: Not in any guide!? Unused Maybe

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物たちをたくさん捕獲しまくり、ついにすべてを 捕まえた！ 夢の魔物牧場が開けるぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: After catching and catching tons of monsters, you've finally caught them all! Now you can open the monster ranch of your dreams!

Entry.JapaneseText: 兄弟（？）との出会い
Entry.EnglishText: Meeting My Sibling (?)
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 83: Enter the Distortion of Memories

Entry.JapaneseText: そっくりなあの人が、何者なのか己自身も知らない。 運命のご対面はいつか果たされるのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Even I don't know what that lookalike truly is. Will our fateful encounter ever come to pass?

Entry.JapaneseText: 兄弟（？）との決別
Entry.EnglishText: Parting Ways with My Sibling (?)

Entry.JapaneseText: 似ているようで全然似てない、そんなあの子。 会わなきゃよかったような、ビターな想いが心に沈む
Entry.EnglishText: That girl seems so similar, yet completely different. A sinking feeling in my heart wishes that we'd never met.

Entry.JapaneseText: らいばるぅ！？
Entry.EnglishText: Rival!?
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_154: クルールはライバル１

Entry.JapaneseText: 四角いアイツがライバル認定。一方的な対抗心は厄介。 マスコット対決の勝敗は目に見えている！？
Entry.EnglishText: Now that square has declared himself your rival. A one-sided rivalry? What a pain... Is this the start of the Battle of the Mascots!?
Entry.Notes: Need to verify context from the skit

Entry.JapaneseText: イキイキいきがい
Entry.EnglishText: A Lively Life's Purpose!
Entry.Notes: Not in any guide!? Unused Maybe Could be ikigai or purpose instead of raison d'être

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物たちを捕獲しまくり、ようやく１００匹達成だ！ これからももっともっと捕まえようぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: After catching and catching tons of monsters, you've already caught 100! But there are plenty more to catch from here!
